lifecycle.activation_contract: Extension Manager verifies RESEARCH_MANIFEST.json, forwards the hash-bound experimental policy, and StateAxis admits only the matching host contract.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable the extension; no stateaxis_chunked_prefill configuration is then supplied and the unmodified scheduler path remains active.

out_of_scope: automatic inheritance from StateAxis aggregate evidence

performance_claims.label: real-online-single-pair-negative
performance_claims.scope: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 on 2x Ascend 910B2; AgentX/agent-research 32 requests at 1 RPS
performance_claims.result: The 256-token candidate improved mean TPOT by 3.46% but regressed mean TTFT by 53.75%; it is not performance-qualified.

performance_claims.label: real-online-off-on-off-smoke-positive-but-n40-negative
performance_claims.scope: official MMLU-Pro materialization, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2, vLLM 0.25.1 host port, infinite-rate burst
performance_claims.result: The 1280-token candidate improved 8-request throughput by 1.54% and 2.97% versus bracketing OFF arms while improving mean TPOT about 26.8%, but the matched 40-request cell regressed throughput 4.46%, mean TTFT 2.98%, and mean TPOT 2.21%; rejected for burst admission.
